## Reference

`DELETE /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}`

Cancels a waiting or queued task. Has no effect on completed/failed tasks.

### Parameters

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `taskId` | path | string | yes | Task ID |

### Responses

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `200` | Task cancelled |
| `404` | Not found |

### Example request

```bash
curl -X DELETE "https://api.bitbybit.dev/api/v1/tasks/{taskId}" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY"
```

Authentication: send your key in the `x-api-key` header. The full machine-readable specification is at [openapi.json](https://learn.bitbybit.dev/openapi.json).
